A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Terminal Velocity Matching work. The main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–F support reliable comparison; the additional page in v3 results from reflow.

before.justification: V1 reports original ImageNet generation results, training and ablation studies, and attention-kernel latency and memory measurements, including Appendix C.2 and Table 5.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, including ImageNet FIDs, ablations, and kernel benchmarks.

M1.justification: The TVM objectives, CFG parameterization, EMA targets, normalization changes, and Flash Attention JVP procedure are unchanged. Algorithm 1 and the sampling and JVP pseudocode also remain unchanged.

E1.justification: The experiments presented in both PDFs retain ImageNet-256×256, ImageNet-512×512, and the same training and kernel test scenarios. V3 links to external text-to-image results but includes no corresponding experiment establishing additional evaluated coverage within the supplied material.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–2 and 5 and the training comparisons, including MeanFlow, IMM, sCT, and vanilla SDPA in their respective experiments. The expanded Boffi et al. discussion introduces no evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The FID/NFE evaluations, model configurations, guidance settings, and training budgets remain unchanged. Table 6 retains 300K training iterations and batch size 2048; the ablations retain 200K steps and batch size 1024.

E4.justification: The time-sampling, CFG, EMA, scaled-parameterization, and t=s ablations are retained unchanged. Training-stability, efficiency, and CFG-conditioned Flow Matching analyses in the main text and Appendix F also remain the same.

E5.justification: Neither version adds seed counts, repeated-training-run statistics, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Section 7.4 retains the same runtime and memory averaging over 10 training steps.

E6.justification: The matched numerical results, plotted trends, and generated samples are unchanged. Tables 1–2 retain one-step FIDs of 3.29 and 4.32 and four-step FIDs of 1.99 and 2.94 for the respective resolutions and configurations; ablation and kernel results also match.

T1.justification: Theorem 1 retains its Lipschitz assumption, weighted bound, and additive constant. The proofs and derivations in the appendices are unchanged; new Appendix E.2 contains only a descriptive statement about prior work.

C1.justification: The central method, theoretical, and ImageNet performance claims are retained. A new abstract footnote modestly extends the advertised application scope by referring to text-to-image results at 10B+ scale, without presenting supporting experiments in the PDF.

C2.justification: Section 4 deletes the warning that separate FM time sampling may deviate from a Wasserstein interpretation. Section 5 removes the local 'up to some constant' qualification and replaces the explicit Lipschitz-enforcement/stability interpretation with broader smoothness wording, while the formal theorem remains unchanged.

D1.justification: V3 adds a first-page access pointer to an external report of 10B+ text-to-image results. This is a limited resource-access addition; implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware information, pseudocode, and existing code-reference information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Boffi et al. (2025), already cited in v1, receives more explicit positioning in Section 6 as a unifying flow-map framework sharing theoretical insights with TVM. New Appendix E.2 mentions its three self-distillation approaches. The bibliography itself is unchanged.

P1.justification: There are localized sentence edits in Sections 4–6, a new footnote and one-sentence Appendix E.2, and an Appendix E title change from 'Prior Works' to 'Other Works.' The overall organization remains intact; some deletions introduce punctuation defects.

P2.justification: The figures and tables retain their content and design. V3 adds the conference running header and a footnote, with limited reflow: Appendix F.3 spills onto a mostly empty page 24, and the unchanged Figure 13 moves to page 25.

improvement.justification: V3 more explicitly acknowledges theoretical overlap with Boffi et al. (2025), improving research positioning. However, it removes qualifications about the Wasserstein interpretation without revising the theorem or supplying an argument resolving the caveat. With unchanged empirical evidence, these competing effects leave the net quality direction unclear.
